notes: Contract says 'fold_d(name)'; implemented with vn_geo.categories.fold_text (public, identical to searchstore.store._entity_fold used by entity dedupe — a documented superset of the đ/Đ-only fold_d). Literal fold_d has no casefold/diacritic strip and would make rule (b) nearly useless; flagged here per 'do not deviate silently'.

run()['groups'] returned as the list of group dicts ({canonical_entity_id, members, method, score}) — same shape as report() — rather than a bare count; contract comment was ambiguous, list is strictly more informative and len() gives the count.

Whitespace-only source_id treated as absent in _record_url (matches place_key's own strip semantics); a literal 'truthy' reading would collapse distinct places onto an empty-slug 'vn://<src>/' url_key.

Per-member method/score = strongest matched edge incident to that member (lowest rule rank, then highest score, then partner id); group method/score = strongest member link. Blocking = tax_code-digit buckets + first folded-name-token buckets exactly as specified; the documented recall tradeoff (a >=0.8-similar pair differing in the first token can be missed) is in the module docstring.

Alias skip is unordered {canonical, alias} so any direction counts; self-alias degenerate pairs are skipped. run_id = 'resolve-<uuid12>' per run. Entities loaded via the 'entities' view (documents_current); missing entity_id falls back to store.entity_id_for.
